protocol.exact_full_identity: Efinal=Haar(EpostSigned)+(0,A1 Qcirc EpostSigned_z)+Rf+Rs; both complete differences include actual A1 velocities and full current pressure reconstruction
protocol.no_claim: actual high-jet/support/background verification, complete new nonzero/physical residual, full canonical seed, absolute decay, infinite field, unconditional pulses or blow-up
protocol.one_common_pole: choose original p for every older nested input; pad paired target allowance d=12p; q=max(previous signed q,6p,6N+9,6N+12p+6), N largest new covariance request; p=1 illustrative q=1200114 at output0, not an actual input enclosure
protocol.operators: prefast rows/fast fields 2q, postfast source/final gr 4q; original shift_recipe(q/3,L,width,gap) covers KT1/KA1 at2q and Kp/Kmom at2q,4q; giant coefficients deferred
protocol.radial: Er=-rho Pnew-A0(gr_final-rho Pnew), zero Haar compensated moment; full final gr source B and Pnew scalar C+1
protocol.rates: B=1-kappa, C=3/2-kappa, D=C-kappa; derived new fast D, fresh postfast scalars C, slow C, postslow scalars C+1; full tangential remainders D+1-2kappa and C+1-2kappa exceed C0
protocol.requests: strict compact rule: p1=50001 J1=n+100005, p0=100000 J0=n+200003 at kappa=1e-5; new covariance requests through J0+13, NEXT signed target through J0+14; old frozen DAGs not collapsed
protocol.result: conditional post-generic-signed fast/slow mean block at full regular mean-row order C0=2-2kappa, with actual A1 velocities and one complete finite request domain
protocol.retained_contract: same actual weighted input/raw kernel families, G=0 on WHOLE reserved potential hull, zero-Haar complete fast fields, unit-mass moving rho, frozen coefficients and whole-line compact smooth supports

remaining_obligations: validate actual same-family weighted coefficient/profile/support/background inequalities through the ENTIRE new and older nested request DAGs, with original p chosen for all finite requested jets
join the complete new signed linear pressure/multiharmonic nonzero residual and all physical compact/Gaussian/base tails on the expanded common domains before claiming the full canonical seed
advance common-family regular orders enough for absolute physical decay; the mean block alone does not prove complete residual improvement
join controlled infinite diagonal and localization products, smooth admissible forcing and complete velocity growth before any blow-up claim

budgets.scope: positive-polynomial functionals and independent rational physical epsilon term budgets; lower actual weighted bounds are not evaluated

exact.scope: exact graph/Laurent conservative row differences with arbitrary complete pressure outputs, plus separate original formal-phase compact inverse controls; not an actual continuum five-map realization
